items.title: Hal Espinosa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 20, 2024
items.q: I didn’t know him, I knew of him in high school looking at the back of Stan Kenton albums.

ctx.x: That’s okay, we can go right and left.
But when I ended up leaving Vegas after six years I went into L.A. instead of working. I befriended Buddy — God how can I forget his name? Lead player with Stan Kenton.
